data.one_liner: Dart wrapper for the Tenrai (formerly Jikan) unofficial MyAnimeList API.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed methods to fetch anime, manga, characters, people, and related data from the Tenrai API. Models are generated with built_value for immutability and JSON parsing.
use_when: You need to read MyAnimeList data without building your own scraper
You want strongly‑typed Dart models for anime/manga information
avoid_when: You require write operations or authentication against MyAnimeList
You need real‑time updates or WebSocket support
strengths: Built‑value models give immutable, type‑safe data
weaknesses: The underlying API is unofficial and may be discontinued
Some endpoints are missing or not yet available
Only GET requests; no support for mutations
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and run `flutter pub get`. No additional permissions required; built_value models may need `build_runner` if you modify them.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight HTTP client for custom API calls without extra abstractions

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: More feature‑rich HTTP client with interceptors, cancellation, and advanced options
